newsitem.title: USA: ProxyMed Inc signs agreement with K&B.
newsitem.headline: ProxyMed Inc signs agreement with K&B.

text.p: ProxyMed Inc said on Thursday it signed a pharmacy network service agreement with K&B Services Inc -- a pharmacy chain with approximately 200 stores in six states.

The agreement enables K&B to continue receiving electronic prescription services through ProxyMed's recently acquired Pre-Scribe network. Additionally, K&B will have access to ProxyMed's national network, ProxyNet(TM). K&B will pay a per-transaction fee for each prescription transmitted to its pharmacies over the networks.
ProxyMed is a healthcare information technology company.
